title: grv-sdlc Project Config
description: Schema for .grv/sdlc.json, the one file every grv-sdlc skill reads project coordinates from (see config-contract.md). Every key is required: an unused capability is expressed with the value none, null or an empty array, never by omitting the key, so a skill can fail closed on absence. Human gates (merge, ticket closure, UAT sign-off, release publication, ruleset changes) are not configurable and have no key here.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema. Ignored by skills.

project.description: Identity of the product or service this repository delivers.

name.description: Human name of the product or service.

key.description: Short lowercase slug used in branch names and skill output.

owner.description: GitHub organization or user that owns the repository.

defaultBranch.description: Branch that pull requests target. Usually main.

requiredChecks.description: Exact names of the required status checks. These are the merge gates; a PR is merge-ready only when every one has reached a final state. An empty array means no check gates a merge and should be recorded as a gap.

mergePolicy.description: The merge method the ruleset allows. Informational for skills: merging is always a human act.

tracker.description: Issue tracker coordinates, transition ids and labels.

type.description: Tracker product. Only jira is supported today.

projectKey.description: Jira project key, for example ABC.

transitions.description: Workflow transition ids. Ids, never display names: display names change and differ per site.

selected.description: Transition id from Backlog to selected-for-development.

inProgress.description: Transition id to In Progress, applied when execution starts.

uat.description: Transition id to UAT, the single human-approval gate.

done.description: Transition id to Done. Written only by a release close-out, on explicit human selection, as its terminal act.

provenance.description: Permanent agent-provenance label, applied at an agent's first write to a ticket and never removed.

stage.description: Stage labels showing live agent activity. Added when an activity starts, removed by name when it ends.

discussing.description: Label while a phase is in discussion.

planning.description: Label while a phase is being planned.

executing.description: Label while a phase is executing.

halted.description: Label when a run stopped at a blocker or human gate.

releaseGateEpic.description: Issue key of the epic gating promotion to live production, or null when no such gate exists yet.

siteUrl.description: Optional. Base URL of the tracker site, used only to build browse links. Skills omit links when absent.

fields.description: Optional. Custom field ids. A skill skips a field whose id is absent; it never guesses one.

storyPoints.description: Custom field id for story points.

track.description: Custom field id for a track or workstream field.

specReference.description: Custom field id for a link to the governing spec.

blocks.description: Name of the Blocks link type.

componentMap.description: Optional. Maps a prefix to a tracker component name. A key ending in / is a repository path prefix; a key ending in - is a requirement-id prefix.

owners.description: Named individuals. A recorded decision names a person, never a team or a role alone.

productOwner.description: Full name of the product owner. Owns business epics and their acceptance.

leadEngineer.description: Full name of the lead engineer. Owns phase Stories and technical epics.

environments.description: Every environment the project deploys to or plans to, including one that does not exist yet. Risk judgements depend on which one is in play.

name.description: Unambiguous environment name. Never a bare word that two environments could both claim.

url.description: Base URL, or null for an environment with no fixed URL (a per-PR preview) or one that does not exist yet.

dataClass.description: synthetic: no real customer data or real-world effect. production: real data or real effect.

promotion.description: auto: a merge or push deploys here with no further act. human: a named person promotes.

chat.description: Team chat used for notify-only pointers.

type.description: Chat product, or none to skip every chat step.

channel.description: Channel name without the leading hash. Null when type is none.

type.description: Documentation product, or none to keep all docs in the repository.

spaceId.description: Confluence space id. Null when type is none.

parentPageId.description: Id of the page new articles are created under. Null when type is none.

compliance.description: Regimes that apply to this project. Drives the flag lines skills print; it is not a compliance claim.

regimes.description: Short regime identifiers, for example SOC2 or GLBA. Empty when none has been established.

gsdCoreMinVersion.description: Minimum gsd-core version the skills were verified on for this repository.

localStack.description: Command that brings up the local stack, or null when there is none.

preview.description: Whether each pull request gets its own preview environment.

targetEnvironment.description: Name of the environments[] entry a release ships to. When absent, release-close derives it and asks if ambiguous.
